name: antigravity-website
description: Kerem Düz - Full Stack Portfolio Website

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n DB,BE,FE -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.seed: cd backend && npm run seed && npm run seed:all
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
